name: Halloween Night Glitch SWEET
original_name: ハロウィンナイト・グリッチSWEET
source:
Halloween has once again come to Ghost Town, the city where the undead live!As usual, Pim (name can be changed) is not keen on the idea……。

It's just a story of lovey-dovey heartwarming in a peaceful world! (After selecting a character, it's a straight path)

[Translated From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15983]Freem![/url]]
translation:
万圣节再次来到鬼城，这座不死族居住的城市！和往常一样，Pim（名字可以更改）并不热衷于这个想法……。

这只是一个和平世界里的恩爱暖心故事！（选择角色后，就是一条直线）

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15983]Freem![/url]]
